rules.name: recon-stuck-02-db-sessions
rules.sql: SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - xact_start))) AS xact_seconds, round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - query_start))) AS query_seconds, left(query, 160) AS query_start_text FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND (query ILIKE '%recon_materialize%' OR query ILIKE '%recon_postprocess%' OR query ILIKE '%recon_%_snapshot%' OR state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') ORDER BY xact_start NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT l.pid, l.granted, a.state, a.application_name, round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - a.xact_start))) AS xact_seconds, left(a.query, 120) AS query_start_text FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory' AND a.datname = current_database() ORDER BY a.xact_start NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND status = 'RUNNING') AS running_runs, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND state = 'active' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND (query ILIKE '%recon_materialize%' OR query ILIKE '%recon_postprocess%')) AS active_backends, (pg_has_role(current_user, 'pg_read_all_stats', 'USAGE') OR coalesce((SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user), false)) AS can_see_others

expect.reason: every RUNNING run has a database session working on it (otherwise the pod died or the work was lost)

expect.expr: #size(#rows('sessions').?[state != null and state.startsWith('idle in transaction') and xact_seconds > 600]) == 0
expect.reason: no session idle in transaction longer than the 600 s export and refresh timeout
